title: Adjoint-normalized scalar endpoints for diagonal diagrams
statement: For a coefficient map $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ and modules in the categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], a prescribed underlying sheaf map is semilinear when it lifts to a module map into restriction of scalars with exactly that underlying map. An endpoint consists of this semilinear map and an isomorphism $La^*(M[0])\simeq N[0]$ whose transpose under the actual derived extension/restriction adjunction of [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] is exactly the single of that semilinear map followed by the inverse exact restriction/single comparison. Its shifted comparison is the canonical derived shift isomorphism followed by this endpoint shifted by two. For the supported source, the scalar map is the coefficient-unit map pushed along the diagonal followed by the canonical ordinary coefficient-restriction/direct-image comparison. No flatness is imposed on $a$, including quotient maps.
